mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_address (id, user_id, receiver_name, phone, detail, is_default, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{phone}, #{detail}, #{isDefault}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM user_address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET is_default = 0, updated_at = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1
